title: Need help with multible item uses MZ

posts.author: Game1637
posts.body:
hi im newer to rpg maker but i lerned a few thing so not a absolute beginner
but i wanted to make an ammo system with multible magazines that hold rounds
i think i have an idear how you could do it with one mag just use a common even and a variable to keep track of the rounds in the mag
with that method i could get one mag working but i want multible magazines that can have differrent ammounts of bullets
my last effort would be to have each magazine as a seperrate item wich would mean 30 items for a 30 bullet mag
is there a better way to acomplish that

posts.author: Andar
posts.body:
Several possibilities
I don't know about MZ, but for earlier makers there were scripts for self-variables stored on items.
If those don't exist, you can request a plugin for an "item use counter" (that would be even more easier than using self-variables
A different option is to have two variables assigned to the weapon itself - one to state the type of ammo loiaded and one for how many bullets are left.
Some people use the TP-track for ammo, but that is only possible if you have no other use for TP. (or MP)
you can also use a skill plugin that allows for ammo cost, and have the bullets become real items to be used for the skill.
